text: Jane Smith works for Acme Corporation, which is based in Riga.
Acme Corporation announced a new office in Riga last year.
Maria Kalnina founded Nexus Trading Group in 2015.
John Carter leads Blackridge Holdings.
Blackridge Holdings acquired Nexus Trading Group in March.
John Carter met with Maria Kalnina in Riga.
Maria Kalnina attended a summit in Riga.
Nexus Trading Group is headquartered in Vilnius.
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said a Canada-EU alliance would create a beacon for other democracies.

UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes. The US has not acknowledged carrying out February's deadly strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd.
Nepal to use new flood study to claim millions from UN climate disaster fund.
Third person dies from malaria in cluster near Germany's Frankfurt Airport. Frankfurt grapples with a rare malaria outbreak tied to air travel.
Yemen escalation displaces more than 57,000 children: UNICEF. Renewed fighting in Yemen is deepening an already severe humanitarian crisis.
Houthi leader Abdul Malik al-Houthi pledges to defend Mecca and other Islamic holy sites.

Wife of US scholar jailed in China asks Trump to raise arrest at Xi meeting. Sylvia Zin is among the family members of people imprisoned in China who are seeking Trump's help when he hosts the country's leader next week.
No fire alarms or sprinklers at Pakistan hospital ward where 14 babies died, report finds. A firefighter tells the BBC that rescuers had said many doors near the unit were locked.
International students, visa hoppers and backpackers targeted in Australia migration crackdown. The government wants to reduce net overseas migration to 225,000 people by 2028.
India faces 100% tariff threat over Russian oil after US House vote. Trump's tariff threat puts India's Russian oil strategy and its access to the US market in a new bind.
India and Pakistan summon diplomats after ships collide in international waters. Both sides accuse each other of causing the collision which happened in the Arabian Sea on Tuesday.
Ilhan Omar attacker sentenced to more than a year in prison. The assailant sprayed vinegar at Ilhan Omar, admitting political motives were behind the assault at a townhall.
Russia sabotaging power supply lines at Zaporizhzhia plant, Greenpeace says. Investigation finds no evidence of Russia's claims that Ukrainian attacks hit the nuclear power plant.
Gender equality woefully off track, new UN report reveals. At the current rate of progress, gender equality would take 171 years to achieve.
Guterres calls for action as hate speech spreads across new platforms online. The UN Secretary-General has called for concerted action by governments, technology companies and civil society.
